what: The five bottom calls of D-228 and D-235 were sent with the word "undefined" where seam-contract-v2's bottoms instruction belonged (modelDraws looked up under "bottom"; the key is "bottoms"). Their pictures, layers and recorded results stand; only conclusions that read a missing waistband, hip-width or hem instruction into the model's behaviour are corrected (docs/decisions/D-245.md).
missingInstruction: Start exactly where the grey base top ends and draw nothing above it. Keep any waistband seam or belt within a finger-width of the top edge; no other horizontal line across the hips. At the hips stay as wide as the grey base shorts. Either end clearly above the ankle (shorts, skirts, capri: the leg shows above any shoe), or end just below the ankle with a straight, square hem that is wider than the leg on both sides.
